landing.heroTitle: The regulated marketplace for pharmaceutical surplus
landing.heroSubtitle: PharmaBridge connects licensed pharmaceutical sellers in Europe with verified buyers worldwide — compliant, traceable, efficient.
landing.pillar1Text: Every batch is screened against the regulatory requirements of every destination country — before visibility, not after.
landing.pillar2Text: Surplus and short-dated stock become revenue instead of destruction costs.
landing.pillar3Text: KYB, license verification and sanctions screening for every organization — no anonymous traders.
landing.pillar4Text: Batch-level documentation and an immutable audit trail across the entire trade.
landing.step1Text: Register your organization, upload licenses, pass KYB review by the compliance team.
landing.step2Text: Create batches with expiry, quantity and documents — individually, via CSV, or later through ERP integration.
landing.step3Text: The engine screens every batch against every destination: registration, remaining shelf life, licenses, sanctions.
landing.step4Text: Negotiate B2B terms. Every transaction passes human compliance approval.
landing.step5Text: GDP-compliant logistics, customs milestones, documentation and payout — in one place.
landing.surplusText: Substantial remaining shelf life (typically 12–36 months) at attractive B2B terms.
landing.shortDatedText: Stock approaching expiry (typically 6–12 months) — only for destinations where import is verifiably permitted.
landing.sellers1: Revenue from surplus instead of write-offs and destruction
landing.sellers2: Visibility only in legally permissible destination markets
landing.sellers3: Batch documentation and audit trail included
landing.buyers2: Transparent shelf life and predictable landed costs
landing.buyers3: Complete compliance documentation with every delivery
landing.complianceText: PharmaBridge is built as a regulated matching system: no trade happens without verified licenses, verified country rules and human compliance approval. Uncertain or unsourced regulation never results in automatic eligibility.

privacyCtrl.title: Privacy
privacyCtrl.exportNote: All personal data linked to your account (GDPR Art. 15).
privacyCtrl.deleteNote: Your profile is irreversibly anonymized and all sessions are terminated (GDPR Art. 17). Trade records subject to legal retention (transactions, batches, compliance decisions, audit) remain, referencing the anonymized account.
privacyCtrl.platformNote: Platform accounts (admin/compliance/analyst) are managed by the platform admin.

bulk.title: Bulk import (CSV)
bulk.hint: Expected columns: product_inn, lot_number, expiry_date (YYYY-MM-DD), quantity — optional: manufacturing_date, unit, temperature_mode. Comma or semicolon delimited.
bulk.cleanRequired: Import only runs once every row is error-free.

compliance.rulesNote: Rules without VERIFIED status never produce automatic eligibility — they force human review. Sources and verification date are part of every rule version.

rulesManage.title: Rule management
rulesManage.publishNote: Publishing supersedes the current version without deleting it: the old version is marked OUTDATED and remains with full history. All open listings are re-evaluated immediately.

countries.title: Countries & trade enablement
countries.gateNote: Enablement requires at least one verified shelf-life rule (step 13 of the country research pipeline). Without verified rules a country can never become tradable.

recalls.title: Recalls
recalls.created: Recall created — {batches} batches locked, {listings} listings blocked, {tx} transactions frozen.
recalls.note: A recall makes affected batches untradable immediately: open listings are blocked, in-flight transactions frozen, all parties notified. Closing the case does not unlock the batches.

sanctions.title: Sanctions screening
sanctions.screeningNote: MVP: manual recording of external list checks. REVIEW and BLOCKED immediately affect every eligibility verdict.

config.title: Platform configuration
config.note: Fees, buffers, thresholds and exclusion lists are configuration — every change is audited and takes effect immediately (60 s cache).

analytics.title: Platform analytics
analytics.savingsWithout: {count} deals without a reference — no savings claimed
analytics.estimateNote: All figures aggregate real records. Savings are computed exclusively against sourced references.

pricing.title: Pricing references

pricing.note: References without a named source cannot be recorded (§17: no fabricated market prices).

shortages.title: Shortage signals
shortages.note: Only lawfully accessed, sourced reports (authority lists, licensed feeds). No scraping.
